data.title: 椎名真白 · 便利店甜点柜前
data.description: 她贴在便利店甜点柜玻璃前，视线锁定年轮蛋糕，手指在玻璃上留下小小的雾气；被问「要买吗」时只是持续点头，动作像等待投喂的猫。
data.action: 指尖轻触玻璃，专注看着柜中的年轮蛋糕。
data.promptProse: Mashiro Shiina stands close to the convenience-store dessert case, staring steadily at the baumkuchen while one fingertip touches the misted glass. She continues nodding at the purchase question, navy school blazer and red ribbon tidy above her pleated skirt. The medium portrait includes stacked desserts inside the case. Display lighting illuminates cake packages and her near cheek, with a faint glass reflection of her face and darker shelving behind.
